Information since March points to solid real activity and a strong labor market, while inflation is running below 2 percent. In line with New Keynesian and expectations-based frameworks, the FOMC’s patient guidance and unchanged target range (2-1/4 to 2-1/2 percent) emphasize forecast targeting and expectations management. The modest IOER adjustment is a technical move to keep the effective rate within the target band, consistent with floor-system operations.

Financial Stability Report (May 2019) context tempers the tone: market functioning and funding risks are generally subdued and equity volatility had eased relative to late 2018, but asset valuations were somewhat elevated and business debt vulnerabilities (including leveraged loans/CLOs) remained high. Taken together, the communication is cautiously optimistic on growth and employment, balanced by muted inflation and pockets of financial vulnerability.
